audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagree with the packet and with their own whys: win[1]='Illaoi' beside whys[1] 'Level 2 stays even'; win[2]='Illaoi' beside whys[2] 'Level 3 remains even'; win[3]='Skill' beside whys[3] 'Level 4 gives you a window'; win[6]='Illaoi' beside whys[6] 'the lane levels'.
audit.why: Packet chart: Skill, Skill, Skill, Wukong, Skill, Illaoi, Skill — and the illaoi__wukong mirror is set to exactly that. Win rate 52.47% over 263 games matches a lane that is mostly even with one Illaoi item window.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; the Levels 4-5 rating raised to 6/10 to match Wukong owning that row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is written as a phase Illaoi wins by creating a 'tentacle field', with no numbers attached.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 450 range and 120/95/70s. It is a commit she has to make from on top of you, off a 120-second cooldown at rank 1 — that is a two-minute punish window, not an ambient zone she carries around.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into spikes[1] and whys[4], matching how the mirror rewrote the same phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) 'Leap of Faith (R) spawns a wall of tentacles' and 'a tentacle field you must never fight inside'. Riot's R text: 'Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.' In a 1v1 lane that is ONE tentacle. The 'wall' only exists in a teamfight. (2) Harsh Lesson does not appear anywhere on the page, in either layer.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4-second dash-and-auto-reset that makes nearby Tentacles swing at the target she leaps to — it is the button she actually trades with in lane, far more often than the 16-second Test of Spirit the whole page is built around.
audit.corrected: Leap of Faith spawns one tentacle per champion hit, so a solo lane cast gives her one. Harsh Lesson (W) is up every 4s and pulls tentacle swings onto you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never explains how becoming a Vessel actually happens — it just says to dodge E.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel.' So running away after being hit is what converts you, and damage dealt to the spirit is what hurts you. That is the whole counterplay and it is absent.
Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever her Tentacles damage a champion, which is what the existing early Executioner's Calling line is buying against.

edits.before: Level 6 evens out as Leap of Faith's tentacle field cancels your all-in advantage.
edits.after: Level 6 evens out as Leap of Faith, 450 range and 120s, punishes your all-in.

edits.before: Level 6 evens out but is deadly: Leap of Faith (R) spawns a wall of tentacles, so never fight her inside a tentacle field — if she ults you in melee range her slam damage is lethal, so back off and re-engage once tentacles decay.
edits.after: Level 6 evens out but is deadly: Leap of Faith is 450 range and 120s at rank 1, so she must stand on top of you to cast it, and it spawns one tentacle per champion hit — in a 1v1 that is one, not a field. Back off, then punish the 120s.

edits.after: Dodge Test of Spirit (E) — 900 range, 16s at rank 1

edits.before: Stack tentacles on the wave to zone and out-trade you
edits.after: Harsh Lesson (W) every 4s to make tentacles swing

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Her vessel pull. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1, 900 range — damage to your spirit echoes onto you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Running away from your own spirit is what turns you into a Vessel.

notes: The packet flags 'Land Test of Spirit' and 'Leap of Faith's' as probable wrong names — both are FALSE POSITIVES; those are the correct ability names. The real errors were elsewhere. Leap of Faith was described as spawning 'a wall of tentacles' and creating a 'tentacle field' in lane; Riot's text spawns one Tentacle per champion hit, so a solo cast gives her exactly one, and the 450 range / 120s at rank 1 make it a huge punish window rather than a zone to fear. Harsh Lesson does not appear anywhere on this page in either layer, despite being a 4-second dash and auto reset that makes nearby tentacles swing at you — it is what she actually trades with, while the entire page is built around a 16-second Test of Spirit. I also wrote in the Vessel condition, which was never explained: damage to your spirit echoes onto you, and running away from the spirit is what converts you. Level chart: four rows contradicted the packet and their own whys; flipped to match the illaoi__wukong mirror.
